notes.title: Watarcade 1.11.1 (Vortex Voyage Rework)
notes.content:
So a while back a fan had some thoughts on Vortex Voyage. I told them I like their ideas and that it would be the next update! It wasn't, but here it is now.

[h1]Vortex Voyage Rework[/h1]
[b]General Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Boom Bullets don’t crash multiplayer
[*] A whole lot of other stuff that would crash multiplayer doesn’t now
[*] Multiplayer chain explosions work
[*] Multiplayer “asteroids” generate correctly
[*] Node explosions visual glitch no longer says “+0” points
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Starting a custom game with 0 for all powerup frequencies no longer crashes the game
[*] You can see powerups on the map after the base has been destroyed
[*] The nodes and edges of bases will become intangible while they are blowing up
[*] Stats for highest amounts of each powerup will mess up stat formatting at higher amounts
[*] Bases are more likely to spawn with an open path to the core
[*] You can hold SHIFT to shoot only 1 bullet. (Instructions now reflect this)
[*] You can now zoom out a little
[*] There is now a manual steering mode if you want a little more challenge when moving. You use your mouse in this mode and can even click to shoot from angles you couldn’t before
[/list]
[b]Lives Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] For the first 100k points, gain 1 life every 10k
[*] Up until 1m, gain 1 life every 50k
[*] Gain 1 life every 100k onward
[/list]
[b]Powerup Changes [/b]
[list]
[*] Green ramp up attack speed slower and has a limit
[*] Blue ramp up move speed slower and has a limit
[*] Yellow now gives a percent chance for bullets to ricochet off of walls
[*] Orange bullets have much less spread and progress to have 5 bullets in each direction
[*] Purple no longer gives lives. Instead, you start firing your own guided missiles
[*] You can now lift the new limits with custom mode
[/list]

[b]Shape Changes [/b]
[list]
[*] All fighter-shapes and node-shapes have dynamic HP dependent on the current wave, and color (except for stars and squares) 
[*] Squares now spawn circles and triangles as well. Later spawning 2 at once. Even later, they start spawning tougher versions
[*] Circle nodes Shoot faster. And even faster the more damaged they are
[*] Triangle nodes now spin after being damaged. After a full rotation, they spawn a triangle fighter. They spin faster the more damage they take
[/list]

- Single Player Menu buttons now say “Play” before “Time Trial”/”Standard”/”Custom”. I hope that makes it clear that's the play button.
- The Sub Wiggly spawn fix
- Forgot to put in a how to play for Marine Survey. It’s in now though
- Made the Yarr Yields instructions more concise
- More messages!

notes.title: Watarcade 1.10
notes.content:
Watarcade 1.10 - Introducing: Yarr Yields

So, I remember saying that updates would come out more frequently. Don't count on that. Anyways, the scope of this update was kinda large. I hope you all enjoy the great additions.

- Added a new hybrid game mode: Yarr Yields. This is a pretty unique game mode. You’re timed and you gotta spend points to make points.
- Added in-game currency. Sorry everyone, it’s here. After playing a non-custom game, a portion of the points earned will be converted into Watarcash (NOTE: Resetting stats does not reset your Watarcash balance)
- Added Fish Tank option. You can now own some permanent fish and feed them whenever you play. Comes with a shop where you can buy these fish and props to decorate your tank. notes.title: Watarcade 1.9 - Introducing: Vortex Voyage
notes.content:
- Added a new hybrid game mode: Vortex Voyage. It is a rogue-like shoot ‘em up.
- Coral Corral’s enemies in multiplayer are less laggy
- Fishy Frenzy’s bullet leading (yellow) slows down shots for better accuracy. You also use it like you would use a red or purple powerup. However, it now slows your movement while this is active.
- Fishy Frenzy’s noclip shots (green) can now be seen inside walls.
- Fishy Frenzy’s “Cragg” map has been reworked for obvious reasons. I don’t have to explain it. I mean like, c’mon, we all know why. 
- Fishy Frenzy map choosing and game lengths have changed. There will now always be 12 rounds (still 2 rotations of the maps). Map selection has changed. Players will pick 6 maps together at the start, however if there are less than 6 players, some players can pick more than 1 map. 
- Fishy Frenzy had a bug fix as well. If two players are hit at the same time, it will be a draw and neither of them will be absent the next round.
- Sea Smash’s invulnerability (orange) has an increased time limit.
- Wavy Nautigate now allows you to LEFT CLICK to drop shapes.
- Wavy Nautigate now correctly tracks the “drops” statistic.
- Wavy Nautigate now correctly tracks the “max merge” statistic.
- Pulling up instructions in single player or multiplayer will now pull up the instructions for the current game you’re on.
- The scrolling text on the menus is quicker to reset now. And it will no longer start going up the screen????? No clue why it did that before. I’m honestly just hoping there is no way it does that again.
- Hopefully fixed a bug in the lobby where player names wouldn’t always appear on the side
- Fixed some General stat totals to include some games
- When starting a multiplayer game, you will now for certain go into the same game.
- Fixed a bug in the lobby where the “Select Manually” button disappeared after a game.

I promise to never repeat my mistake with Cragg ever again. I hope I can be better in the future.

notes.title: Watarcade 1.8 - Introducing: Beacheweled (1 Year Anniversary!!!)
notes.content:
- Added a new single player only game mode: Beacheweled. C’mon you have to know what this is.
- Added new scrolling messages
- Made the single player only menu a green shade for easier differentiation
- Coral Corral’s timer now turns red at 10 seconds or fewer left
- Mariana Matching now plays some bleeps, bloops, and bangs when the timer is close to running out and when it does run out
- Fixed some issues with overlapping in the single player menus
- In honor of the anniversary, I added some default highscores. Try beating them! 

Watarcade has been out for a whole year now. It started with 10 minigames with a very laggy multiplayer. Now it has 18 minigames. 

But it won’t stop there. I developed Watarcade by myself during college. I am now graduated with much more time on my hands to make even more minigames this year. 

So you may be wondering what’s next for Watarcade. I’ve gotten pretty comfortable making single player exclusive minigames, so now I think it's time for some multiplayer exclusives as well as single-multiplayer minigames.

-Alivextris
